wish: someone should make a tool that shows the differences between two images
spec:
Compares two images pixel by pixel, paints every differing pixel red, boxes the changed area and says whether they are identical.
Pick, drop or paste two images; switch between Diff, Slider and Blink views; raise the tolerance to ignore compression noise.
It does not align shifted or rotated images, and nothing leaves the device.
notes: Images are compared at full resolution up to 16 MP, scaled equally above that. Different sizes are compared from the top-left corner.
